priorityList: Cast Avenging Wrath (if Radiant Glory is not talented)
Cast Divine Storm if you have 5 Holy Power
Cast Blade of Justice with an Art of War proc
Cast Templar Strikes or Templar Slash (if talented)
Cast Crusader Strike (if neither Templar Strikes nor Crusading Strikes are talented)
Cast Wake of Ashes if you have 2 or fewer Holy Power to generate resources and apply Dawnlight.
Cast Divine Storm if you have 5 Holy Power or an active Empyrean Armor proc.
Cast Divine Toll on cooldown to generate Holy Power and apply Greater Judgment to multiple targets.
Cast Hammer of Wrath whenever available to generate Holy Power.
Cast Templar Strikes (first and second strikes) to generate Holy Power.
Cast Judgment to generate Holy Power and apply the Mastery: Highlord's Judgment debuff.
Cast Divine Storm at 3 or 4 Holy Power if no other Holy Power generators are available.
